descriptor.name: City of Oshawa assessed parcels of land
descriptor.scope: City of Oshawa municipal assessed parcels of land (FCODE=2150); assessed condominium records (FCODE=9920) are a separate documented theme.
descriptor.licenceNote: Official metadata specifies reference use only; reuse licence is unconfirmed.

evidence: Frozen city packet and service review identify the City of Oshawa polygon layer Operational/Parcels_AddPts/MapServer/1 and PARCELID identities; official metadata independently states: "To display property ownership boundaries (parcels) within the City of Oshawa." https://map.oshawa.ca/OpenData/Metadata/Parcel%20Metadata.pdf

Official metadata defines FCODE 2150 as assessed parcels of land and FCODE 9920 as assessed condominiums; this candidate fixes FCODE=2150 as its assessed-land scope. Live layer schema confirms polygon geometry, EPSG:26917, string PARCELID, OBJECTID, FCODE and GeoJSON/pagination support. See attempt-01/evidence/official-contract.json.
